_comment: Pick-lists for the Search profile page (English).  'positions' are the job types users can tick; each has a multilingual title pattern (regex, case-insensitive) so ads in any language are recognised.  If an ad title is one of these types and the user did not tick it, the ad is not shown in New matches.  'absorb': a specific type hides the generic ones it implies.  Edit in the dev copy - installing a new version replaces this file.

positions.label: Postdoc
positions.pattern: post[\s\-]?doc|postdoctora|post[\s\-]?doktor|post[\s\-]?doctorant|posdoctora|posdoc|tutkijatohtori|assegn(o|ista|i) di ricerca|assegnista|juan de la cierva|marie curie fellow|research associate|wissenschaftliche[rn]? mitarbeiter.{0,30}postdoc

positions.label: PhD position
positions.pattern: ph\.?\s?d\.?[\s\-]research fellow|(?<!post)(?<!post-)(?<!post )doctoral research fellow|ph\.?\s?d\.?[\s\-]?(student|position|candidate|fellow|scholarship|studentship|stipend|project)|doktorand|(?<!post)(?<!post-)(?<!post )doctoral (student|candidate|position|researcher|fellow)|(?<!post)(?<!post-)doctorant|contrat doctoral|väitöskirjatutkija|dottorand|dottorato|predoctoral|pre-doctoral|stipendiat|(?<!post)doctoral studentship|early stage researcher|\besr\b

positions.label: Research assistant
positions.pattern: research assistant|forskningsassistent|assistant de recherche|ayudante de investigación|amanuens|tutkimusavustaja|borsa di ricerca|borsista

positions.label: Lab manager / technician
positions.pattern: lab(oratory)? (manager|technician|engineer|assistant|coordinator)|technician|biomedical analyst|biomedicinsk analytiker|laborant|technicien|técnico de laboratorio|tecnico di laboratorio

positions.label: Lecturer / assistant professor
positions.pattern: lecturer|assistant professor|tenure[\s\-]?track|universitetslektor|biträdande lektor|\blektor\b|\badjunkt\b|maître de conférences|maitre de conferences|profesor ayudante|ricercatore a tempo determinato|\brtd\b|yliopistonlehtori|apulaisprofessori|førsteamanuensis|tenure
